text: Coin Margin Futures what is a Coin Margin Futures contract? Coin margin futures contracts are a type of derivative that derives its value from an underlying cryptocurrency. Unlike USDT margined contracts, the margin and potential PNL of coin margined contracts will be denominated in cryptocurrencies such as BTC or ETH instead of usdt. Investors should understand what contract codes mean in order to understand expirations. Contract codes typically convey information about its underlying asset, quote asset, and expiration date. Let's use the BTC USD Perpetual coinmargent Contract as an example. The first code labeled BTC refers to the underlying asset, in this case Bitcoin. The following code USD refers to US Dollars, which is the quote asset. Lastly, perpetual refers to the term maturity of the contract. In this case, perpetual contracts allow traders to hold positions without an expiry date. In addition to perpetual contracts, Binance offers quarterly contracts which offer a slight variation. Quarterly contracts have a limited lifespan and they will expire based on their respective calendar cycle. For instance, a BTC USD December 25 quarterly contract expires on the stipulated expiration date which is December 25th.
